premises.text: Spends differentiates budgeting as fast, anonymous, proactive, and gamified rather than bank-linked
premises.evidence_span: First, we're going to make inputs fast, super fast. I want you to be able to whip out your phone and input any expense in under three seconds. Secondly, when it comes to your money, anonymous is a good thing

premises.text: Tag suggestions follow the pattern and frequency of the user's spending
premises.evidence_span: Spends tracks both the pattern and frequency of my top tags and intuitively responds

premises.text: Experience points, tokens, achievements, and levels encourage tracking habits
premises.evidence_span: achievements are ways that we encourage our users to do some great spending habits

premises.text: Tokens unlock featured deals matched to spending habits as the primary monetization path
premises.evidence_span: one of the first ways we're going to make money is by working with companies to get the right deals in front of the right audience

premises.text: Subcategory budgets and demographic You-Versus-Them insights deepen tracking beyond a single budget number
premises.evidence_span: with the You Versus Them feature, I can show you insights like never before

premises.text: The product remains free for users
premises.evidence_span: For users, Spends will always be free

domains.name: Deal monetization while free to users

value.text: Know where your money goes by budgeting and tracking in a fun, fast way
value.evidence_span: I have no idea where my money goes

notes: Folded four differentiators into one product stance premise with supporting tag and gamification premises. Free-to-user kept with deals as commercial structure (v1.3.1 §4.1(3)). Web sync folded into product, not coded separately. Singleton D2: budgets/insights module presented as going 'one step farther' beyond input gamification.
